correctness.summary: The five regimes and constants are algebraically identical to the earlier repository theorem. The beta zero-CDF imbalance and Bessel-K small-argument expansion produce the thresholds at r=1 and r=3; the r=2 coefficient is 1/2 as required by the exact asymmetric-Laplace median. Substituting the Wishart off-diagonal VG parameters reproduces the stated n=1,2,3 and n>3 small-correlation formulas.
